title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1966-10-07

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality soundboard capture of a rare 1966 Dead show with standout Cream Puff War, Little School Girl and Stealin', though the exact date/venue is heavily disputed.
ai_review.review: Listeners praise the tape for its surprisingly clear 1966 sound and highlight Jerry Garcia’s unique licks on Stealin' as well as strong performances of Cream Puff War and Little School Girl.  The recording is generally regarded as a solid soundboard source, but many reviewers are uncertain whether the concert actually took place at Winterland or was moved to the Fillmore, which colors the overall impression.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give high marks for performance and sound quality, but a sizable minority dispute the concert’s authenticity, pulling the average down to a solid but not outstanding rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several reviewers note the tape is well‑cut for its era and sounds good overall; one mentions a weak vocal on a song, but no major dropouts or balance issues are reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A brief three‑song set that fans find rare and exciting; the flow is praised for its energy, though uncertainty about the exact venue/date tempers enthusiasm.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s licks on Stealin' are called “unique” and “outstanding,” with several reviewers highlighting his guitar work.
